New protocol (60): everyone in a session needs 0.12.0; it doesn't play with 0.11.2
Shared workshop materials: with the host's bSharedStorage on, each host settlement's workbench is one pile for both players
A friend's water pumps, crops, generators and defenses count in your settlement's numbers too
sQuests = safe (or "More quests" in the host's F1 menu) shares 92 more quests found safe to share
A friend who sits down no longer shows standing beside the seat
Full notes on GitHub
